what: One figure, a single mesh, stored losslessly seven ways. Sizes in bytes.
notes: The .bread sizes are the MESH chunk with its 26-byte header, as the reference implementation 0.2.0 + main compresses it (zstd level 3). A whole file adds the 10-byte file header and a scene chunk of a few dozen bytes.
The STL has a facet normal per triangle, computed from its corners and normalized, as STL writers do, and zero attribute bytes.
The OBJ has a 'v' line per vertex, each coordinate the shortest decimal that reads back as the same f32, and an 'f' line per triangle.
notes/measurements.md says how each was made.
